Privacy.title: Privacy Policy — Bubble
Privacy.intro: Bubble respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect and use your data to provide a personalized music streaming experience.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.desc: To provide our streaming services, we collect the following information:
section1.personal: Account Info: Name and Email address.
section1.activity: Listening Activity: Your last 50 played songs and your last recently played playlists, artists, and albums.
section1.library: Library Data: Your created playlists, liked songs, playlists, artists, albums.
section1.media: Media: Bubble does not allow user media uploads. All music and art are served via our internal API.

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
section2.use:
To manage your music library and playlists.
To provide personalized recommendations using our recommendation engine.
To analyze internal popularity trends (no third-party tracking).
To synchronize your experience across sessions.
section2.no:
We do not:
Use Google Analytics, Mixpanel, or other third-party trackers.
Sell your listening history to advertisers.

section3.title: 3. Storage & Technology
section3.desc: Your data is stored securely using Supabase (Postgres for data and Storage for audio files).
section3.cookies: Cookies: Used to remember your language preferences and theme settings.
section3.local: LocalStorage: Used to save your volume levels and to batch playback signals (e.g., tracking the last 5 songs played) to generate recommendation embeddings.

section4.title: 4. Authentication
section4.desc: We use Supabase Auth for secure login via Email/Password or Google OAuth.

section5.title: 5. Data Sharing
section5.desc: Your personal data and listening history are never shared with third parties, except for our core infrastructure providers (Supabase and Vercel).

section6.title: 6. User Control & Deletion
section6.desc: As Bubble is currently in a demo project, automated account deletion through the dashboard is not yet supported. If you wish to have your data removed, please contact us via email.

section7.title: 7. Security
section7.desc: We implement standard security practices to protect your account and listening data, though no internet-based system is 100% secure.

Terms.title: Terms & Conditions – Bubble
Terms.intro: By accessing Bubble, you agree to the following terms and conditions:

section1.title: 1. Project Nature
section1.desc: Bubble is a non-commercial, personal demonstration project developed by Aung Chan Pyae
section1.demo: As this is a demo, features may change, service may go offline without notice, and user data (like playlists) may be reset at any time.

section2.title: 2. Intellectual Property Disclaimer
section2.warning: ⚠️ Disclaimer: This project is a non-commercial personal demonstration project. I do not own or claim copyright for any songs or images stored or used in this application. All media content is used strictly for demonstration purposes. I only own the source code written for this project.

section3.title: 3. Music Usage & Downloads
section3.items:
• Music is provided primarily for streaming demonstration.
• Users may download music files for personal use at their own risk.
• You agree not to distribute downloaded files using the 'Bubble' name or brand.
• This service must not be used for public or commercial broadcasting (e.g., in shops or cafes).

section4.title: 4. User Accounts
section4.items:
• You may use nicknames; real names are not required.
• Multiple people are permitted to share a single account.
• We reserve the right to ban or block any user who attempts to hack, exploit, or abuse the system/API.

section5.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
section5.desc: The developer is not responsible for any copyright issues arising from user downloads or any damages/data loss caused by using this demo application. The service is provided 'as-is'.
